$comment: Agent-OS-owned Claude event wiring. SOURCE DATA for projectSeatHooks, never a target artifact:
the harness reads .claude/settings.json, and this file is reconciled INTO it entry-by-entry
after the Engine template hydrates. It therefore declares only the events Agent OS owns.
PreToolUse -> rgReplaceGuardHook is deliberately ABSENT: that guard is Engine-owned and tracked
(ADR 0040 2.7), so the Engine template hydrates it and the projector must preserve rather than
restate it. Restating it here would make the Brain the second author of an Engine entry.
Timeouts are part of the contract, not decoration: wakeArmingHook exports HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000
and derives its MCP exchange budget from it, so a drift between that constant and the 15 below
silently shortens the window the hook believes it has.
Commands are byte-identical to the pre-cut Engine template at c623b2f63c^, so the reconciliation
restores the wiring that existed rather than a re-derived approximation.
